dial.summary: TOTAL crypto market cap fell to ~$2.63T on October 31 following the October 30 liquidation cascade ($1.49B, 86.8% longs flushed); DXY holds above 101 sustaining a macro headwind despite real yields falling ~30bps in October and the Fed balance sheet stabilizing at $6.75T; Global M2 (G4 aggregate) edged down to ~$103.9T in October, shifting the 4-week trend to flat and removing the prior supportive signal; with TOTAL in a downtrend, DXY elevated, and macro signals mixed, Risk Off posture is maintained.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: StreetStats G4 aggregate (US/Euro Zone/China/Japan) at ~$103,889B (~$103.9T) as of October 30, 2026 — slightly below the MacroMicro September 2026 figure of ~$104,317B ($104.3T); 4-week comparison yields a small decline of ~$428B (~-0.4%), but the two sources use different methodologies and exchange-rate conventions, making the change within noise; US M2 at $23.41T in September 2026 (H.6 updated Oct 27; +5.7% YoY) confirms no YoY contraction; 4-week trend called FLAT (source-adjusted uncertainty); status neutral per rules (4-week trend is not clearly up, and no YoY contraction headwind); next MacroMicro G4 update expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI due Monday November 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET — not yet released at time of run (November 1 is Saturday); latest confirmed reading remains September 2026 at 54.5% (ninth consecutive month above 50); S&P Global flash October US Manufacturing PMI at 56.0 (up from 55.9 September) suggests resilience on a separate survey; Polymarket forecasting range 54–55 for October ISM; 4-week trend FLAT (no change to confirmed ISM reading); status neutral (above 50 but no 4-week ISM increase confirmed).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot ~101.96 on October 31, 2026 (Trading Economics; day range $101.57–$102.0); November 1 is Saturday with no new market data; 4-week trend UP (~100.5 end-September 2026 → 101.96 October 31, +1.5%); status headwind (above 100 threshold); DXY sustained above 100 for the entirety of October 2026; BOJ held at 1.25% on October 30 with a hawkish December signal and Q3 GDP at 3.4% reinforcing USD bid; 52-week high ~102.94.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) closed at 2.63% on October 29, 2026 (portfolio-terminal.com); October month-to-date average ~2.64% (portfolio-terminal.com); 4-week trend DOWN — fell from ~2.93% at end-September 2026 to 2.63% on October 29, a decline of ~30bps, the steepest monthly improvement since June 2026; status supportive per rules (falling trend); November 1–2 are weekend/holiday-adjacent days, next FRED DFII10 update expected Monday November 3; absolute level at 2.63% remains restrictive in conventional terms.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 30, 2026: 10Y ~4.927%, 2Y ~4.586%, spread ~+34bps; November 1 is Saturday, no new data; 4-week trend DOWN (from ~+42bps on October 1 to ~+34bps on October 30, -8bps flattening); 2Y fell ~6bps on Oct 30 as markets priced December FOMC hold probability; curve remains positive (well above -50bps headwind threshold); status neutral (positive but flattening, not steepening); next FOMC decision December 9, 2026 (policy rate 3.875%).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL weekly data (H.4.1 released October 29, 2026): Sep 30 $6,743,031M → Oct 7 $6,747,560M → Oct 14 $6,755,639M → Oct 21 $6,753,604M → Oct 28 $6,745,635M ($6.75T); 4-week change Sep 30 to Oct 28 = +$2.6B ≈ 0%, flat; balance sheet has oscillated in a narrow ~$12B band over the past month; next H.4.1 release November 5, 2026; status supportive (flat post-QT-pause stabilization plateau; no aggressive QT and overnight rates stable).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: No confirmed OI-weighted aggregate funding rate figure available for November 1, 2026 post-crash; value held at last reliable snapshot (~0.0087% per 8h, OI-weighted aggregate ~Oct 23 per DeFiRate); available data points: MacroMicro aggregate 0.0067% on Sep 30; OKX single-exchange 0.0025% on Oct 7; October 30 crash ($1.49B liquidations, 86.8% longs flushed) almost certainly pushed funding toward zero or slightly negative post-flush; 30-day trend DOWN (declining from early-October highs); status supportive (well below 0.04% headwind threshold; post-liquidation environment); CoinGlass blocked in this session — confirm via live CoinGlass for updated aggregate.

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$303.8B (DefiLlama Oct 25, 2026; USDT 60.64% share within stablecoins); total crypto market cap ~$2.63T (TokenPost Oct 31, 2026; BTC at $77,566, BTC.D 59.2%); implied stablecoin dominance ~$303.8B / $2,630B ≈ 11.6%; 30-day trend UP (Sep 30 ~10.5% → Oct 31 ~11.6%, +1.1pp); rising dominance driven primarily by falling TOTAL (October 30 crash -2.05% on Oct 31) rather than new stablecoin inflows; status neutral — headwind condition requires rising stablecoin dom AND rising TOTAL simultaneously; TOTAL is declining.

upcoming.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases October 2026 Manufacturing PMI at 10:00 AM ET — tomorrow's print is the first October macro read and a key December 9 FOMC input; September ISM was 54.5% (ninth consecutive month of expansion) with Prices Paid at 77.9%; S&P Global flash October Manufacturing PMI came in at 56.0 (up from 55.9), providing an upside preview; a print at or above 56 would strengthen December hiking odds and further pressure risk assets already reeling from the October 30 crash; Polymarket consensus clusters in the 54–55 range.

upcoming.title: US Midterm Elections 2026
upcoming.note: US Midterm Elections on the first Tuesday of November — Congress control determines the fiscal policy and regulatory backdrop for the next two years; outcomes affecting House and Senate composition will drive near-term sentiment on fiscal stimulus, crypto regulation, and deficit trajectory; results typically flow overnight into early Wednesday; a surprise shift in Congressional control could reprice inflation expectations and December FOMC positioning.

upcoming.title: JOLTS Job Openings (September 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases September 2026 Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) at 10:00 AM ET — context: September NFP was +29K (weakest of the cycle) and October NFP is Friday; a sharp drop in openings below 7M would confirm broad labor softening and complicate December 9 FOMC hiking narrative; released same day as Midterm Election results, amplifying market volatility potential.

upcoming.title: ADP Employment Report (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ADP releases October 2026 National Employment Report at 8:15 AM ET — private-sector payroll preview ahead of BLS NFP on November 6; September NFP was +29K (weakest of the cycle); an ADP beat above 100K would raise October NFP expectations and reinforce December 9 hiking odds, adding to the post-crash DXY headwind for risk assets; a second consecutive weak print would amplify recession concerns.

upcoming.title: ISM Services PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases October 2026 Services PMI at 10:00 AM ET — released same day as ADP; services sector accounts for ~70% of US GDP; a miss below 50 would be an outsized macro signal on top of the October 30 crash aftermath; a combined strong Services PMI and ADP beat would solidify December 9 hiking expectations and sustain DXY headwind and real yield pressure on risk assets.

upcoming.title: Bank of England Rate Decision (November 2026)
upcoming.note: Bank of England MPC announces Bank Rate at 12:00 PM UK time with Monetary Policy Report — current Bank Rate at 3.75% (held September 17, 6-3 vote); a hold is the base case; a surprise hike or hawkish guidance would strengthen GBP, add to global tightening pressure, and provide context alongside the BOJ's October 30 hold at 1.25% with hawkish December signal — three major central banks (Fed, BOJ, BOE) all leaning hawkish into year-end.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended November 1, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended November 1 — released same morning as BOE decision; a spike above 230K would temper December 9 FOMC hike expectations and could amplify risk-off pressure following the October 30 crash ($1.49B liquidations); sets the tone one day before the October NFP print.

upcoming.title: US Employment Situation — NFP (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 nonfarm payrolls at 8:30 AM ET — the critical December 9 FOMC input; September NFP was +29K (weakest of the cycle, well below consensus); a rebound toward 100K+ would stabilize the labor narrative and support December hiking expectations, sustaining DXY headwind above 101; a second consecutive sub-50K print would shift FOMC pricing toward a hold and could provide relief for risk assets, especially crypto still recovering from October 30 crash.
